purpose: Preserve the chronological history of blockers affecting controlled property fixture revalidation.
history_rules: Every material blocker state receives a new immutable entry.
Blocker closure requires recorded evidence of the required action.
Historical blocker states are never silently overwritten.
Technical blocker history remains separate from legal-source and publication history.

entries.required_action: Obtain or explicitly approve a corrected/replacement controlled fixture through fixture governance.

guardrails: This is technical governance history only.
It does not establish legal facts or property ownership.
It does not represent live official-record retrieval.
A later blocker state must be recorded as a new entry.
